(g) Maintain National Crop Varieties and Livestock Breeds Register
(h) Enforce seed quality standards and specifications
(i) Conduct seed testing in certification laboratories
(j) Enforce seed labeling and packaging requirements
(k) Combat fake and adulterated seeds harming farmers
(l) Promote use of improved and certified seeds
(m) Protect plant breeders' rights and intellectual property
(n) Inspect seed production fields ensuring quality
(o) Monitor seed storage and handling facilities
(p) Coordinate with research institutes on variety release processes
(q) Develop seed policies and regulations
(r) Promote local seed production capacity
(s) Train seed inspectors and certification personnel
(t) Advance agricultural productivity through quality seed regulation ensuring farmers access genetically pure, high-yielding and disease-free seeds critical for crop production

mda_name: 590. NATIONAL ANIMAL PRODUCTION RESEARCH INSTITUTE (NAPRI), ZARIA
mandate_description:
National Animal Production Research Institute (NAPRI) is premier federal livestock research institution conducting research on animal production and livestock development. Located at Ahmadu Bello University, Shika, Zaria, Kaduna State, operating under Agricultural Research Council of Nigeria and Federal Ministry of Agriculture. Established to conduct research on cattle, sheep, goats, poultry, pigs and other livestock. Researches livestock breeds improvement through genetics and breeding programs. Develops improved livestock management and feeding systems. Conducts animal nutrition research on feed formulation. Researches livestock diseases, animal health and veterinary medicine. Develops animal production technologies for tropical conditions. Conducts range and pasture management research. Researches livestock-crop integration systems. Develops technologies for smallholder livestock farmers. Multiplies and distributes improved livestock breeds and germplasm. Provides training for livestock extension workers. Collaborates with veterinary schools, livestock departments and international livestock research centers. Addresses challenges from pastoralist-farmer conflicts, inadequate veterinary services and low livestock productivity. Critical for livestock sector development, meat/milk production and pastoral communities' livelihoods.

**Core Mandate:** To conduct livestock research, develop improved animal breeds, research animal nutrition and health, and support livestock productivity and development in Nigeria.

**Statutory Functions:**
(a) Conduct research on cattle, sheep, goats and small ruminant production
(b) Research poultry production including chickens, turkeys and guinea fowl
(c) Develop improved livestock breeds through genetics and breeding programs
(d) Research animal nutrition and feed formulation
(e) Conduct animal health research on livestock diseases
(f) Research veterinary medicine and disease control strategies
(g) Develop livestock management systems for tropical conditions
(h) Conduct range and pasture management research
(i) Research forage crops for livestock feeding
(j) Develop livestock-crop integration and mixed farming systems
(k) Research dairy production and milk quality
(l) Study meat production and meat quality improvement
(m) Conduct pig production research
(n) Research rabbit and grasscutter production
(o) Multiply and distribute improved livestock breeds to farmers
(p) Provide training for livestock extension workers
(q) Conduct adaptive research on livestock technologies
(r) Collaborate with veterinary schools and livestock departments
(s) Engage international livestock research centers (ILRI, ILCA)
(t) Advance livestock productivity, meat and milk production supporting pastoral livelihoods and animal protein supply through research addressing livestock sector challenges

mda_name: 591. NATIONAL ARBOVIRUS AND VECTOR RESEARCH CENTRE (NAVRC)
mandate_description:
National Arbovirus and Vector Research Centre is specialized federal research institution studying arboviruses (arthropod-borne viruses) and disease vectors. Operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Conducts research on mosquito-borne diseases including yellow fever, dengue fever and chikungunya. Studies Lassa fever and other viral hemorrhagic fevers. Researches disease-carrying mosquitoes, ticks and other vectors. Conducts arbovirus surveillance and outbreak investigations. Operates virology laboratory diagnosing arboviral diseases. Studies vector ecology, behavior and control strategies. Researches insecticide resistance in mosquito populations. Develops vector control interventions. Provides technical support during disease outbreaks. Trains public health personnel on arbovirus detection and vector control. Collaborates with NCDC, WHO and international arbovirus research networks. Addresses challenges from emerging arboviral diseases, climate change affecting vector distribution and limited laboratory capacity. Critical for epidemic preparedness, vector-borne disease control and protecting Nigeria from arboviral outbreaks including yellow fever endemic in Nigeria.

**Core Mandate:** To conduct arbovirus research, study disease vectors, provide arboviral disease surveillance, develop vector control strategies and support outbreak prevention and response.

**Statutory Functions:**
(a) Conduct research on arboviruses including yellow fever, dengue and chikungunya
(b) Study mosquito-borne viral diseases affecting Nigeria
(c) Research Lassa fever and viral hemorrhagic fevers
(d) Study disease-carrying mosquitoes including Aedes and Anopheles species
(e) Research ticks, sandflies and other disease vectors
(f) Conduct arbovirus surveillance and epidemiological monitoring
(g) Investigate arboviral disease outbreaks and epidemics
(h) Operate virology laboratory for arbovirus diagnosis
(i) Study vector ecology, distribution and breeding patterns
(j) Research mosquito behavior and biting patterns
(k) Develop vector control strategies and interventions
(l) Study insecticide resistance in mosquito populations
(m) Research biological control of disease vectors
(n) Develop integrated vector management approaches
(o) Provide technical support during yellow fever and dengue outbreaks
(p) Train public health personnel on arbovirus detection
(q) Conduct environmental health research on vector habitats
(r) Collaborate with NCDC on outbreak response
(s) Engage WHO and international arbovirus research networks
(t) Advance arboviral disease prevention and epidemic preparedness through vector research supporting Nigeria's defense against yellow fever, dengue and emerging arboviral threats

mda_name: 592. NATIONAL AUTOMOTIVE DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL (NADDC)
mandate_description:
National Automotive Design and Development Council is federal agency promoting automotive industry development and local vehicle manufacturing. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Industry, Trade and Investment. Established to develop indigenous automotive design, manufacturing and assembly capacity. Implements National Automotive Industry Development Plan promoting local content. Provides incentives for vehicle assembly plants in Nigeria. Regulates automotive industry and vehicle importation. Promotes local manufacturing of vehicle components and parts. Develops automotive value chain from components to assembly. Encourages technology transfer from foreign automotive companies. Supports automotive engineering training and skills development. Collaborates with vehicle assembly plants (Innoson, Peugeot, Stallion, etc.). Implements automotive policies including import duty waivers for assembly plants. Promotes research in automotive design and engineering. Addresses challenges from competition with imported used vehicles, limited local content and infrastructure gaps. Nigeria's automotive policy aims to make country regional automotive manufacturing hub. Critical for industrialization, employment creation and reducing vehicle import dependence.

**Core Mandate:** To promote automotive industry development, support local vehicle manufacturing and assembly, develop automotive value chain and advance Nigeria's automotive industrialization.

**Statutory Functions:**

(b) Implement National Automotive Industry Development Plan
(c) Regulate automotive industry and vehicle assembly operations

(e) Promote local manufacturing of vehicle components and parts
(f) Develop automotive value chain and supplier networks
(g) Encourage technology transfer from foreign automotive companies
(h) Support automotive engineering training and skills development
(i) Collaborate with vehicle assembly plants (Innoson, Peugeot, Stallion, others)
(j) Implement import duty policies favoring local assembly
(k) Promote automotive research, design and engineering
(l) Develop automotive testing facilities and standards
(m) Support automotive component manufacturers
(n) Promote local content in automotive production
(o) Regulate vehicle importation and standards
(p) Develop automotive industry statistics and databases
(q) Attract foreign automotive investment and partnerships
(r) Promote electric and alternative fuel vehicles
(s) Coordinate with NADDC offices and automotive stakeholders
(t) Advance automotive industrialization, employment creation and vehicle manufacturing reducing import dependence and making Nigeria regional automotive hub

National Biosafety Management Agency is federal regulatory agency overseeing biotechnology, genetically modified organisms (GMOs) and biosafety. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Environment. Established by National Biosafety Management Agency Act 2015 to regulate modern biotechnology applications ensuring safety. Regulates GMO research, field trials, importation and commercial release. Conducts biosafety risk assessments for GMO applications. Issues permits for confined field trials of GMO crops. Approves commercial release of GMO crops meeting safety standards. Regulates GMO imports including food aid and agricultural commodities. Enforces biosafety protocols and containment measures. Monitors environmental and health impacts of GMOs. Promotes public awareness on biotechnology and GMOs. Collaborates with research institutes conducting GMO research. Implements Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety. Addresses challenges from public skepticism about GMOs, limited capacity and conflicting interests between innovation and precaution. Nigeria has approved GMO cowpea (beans) and cotton for cultivation. Critical for regulating biotechnology development balancing innovation with safety and environmental protection.

**Core Mandate:** To regulate biotechnology and GMOs, ensure biosafety compliance, conduct risk assessments, approve GMO releases and protect human health and environment from biotechnology risks.

(e) Regulate importation of GMO products including food and feed
(f) Enforce biosafety protocols and containment measures
(g) Monitor environmental impacts of GMO releases
(h) Assess human health risks from GMO crops and products
(i) Regulate GMO handling, transport and storage
(j) Conduct post-release monitoring of commercial GMOs
(k) Promote public awareness on biotechnology and biosafety
(l) Collaborate with research institutes on GMO development
(m) Implement Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety obligations
(n) Maintain National Biosafety Database on GMO applications
(o) Enforce labeling requirements for GMO products
(p) Address illegal GMO releases and violations
(q) Provide technical guidance on biosafety to stakeholders
(r) Coordinate with NAFDAC on GMO food safety
(s) Engage international biosafety networks and agencies
(t) Advance safe biotechnology development balancing innovation with precaution ensuring GMO applications protect human health and environment while supporting agricultural productivity

National Biotechnology Development Agency is federal agency promoting biotechnology research, development and commercialization. Headquartered in Abuja with biotechnology centers nationwide, operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Established to harness biotechnology for national development addressing food security, health and industrial challenges. Operates biotechnology research centers conducting agricultural, medical and industrial biotechnology. Develops genetically modified crops including disease-resistant varieties. Conducts vaccine development and biopharmaceutical research. Researches industrial biotechnology for bio-based products. Promotes tissue culture for crop propagation. Develops biosensors and diagnostic technologies. Provides biotechnology training and capacity building. Operates modern biotechnology laboratories with genetic engineering facilities. Collaborates with universities, research institutes and biotech companies. Promotes bioentrepreneurship and biotechnology commercialization. Addresses challenges from limited commercialization, biosafety regulations and technology transfer gaps. Complements NBMA's regulatory role focusing on research and development. Critical for biotechnology innovation, technology development and applying genetic engineering to Nigeria's development challenges.

**Core Mandate:** To promote biotechnology research and development, build biotechnology capacity, commercialize biotechnology innovations and apply biotechnology to agriculture, health and industrial development.

(t) Advance biotechnology innovation addressing food security, health and industrial development through research, training and commercialization

National Blood Service Commission is federal agency managing blood transfusion services and ensuring safe blood supply. Operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established to coordinate blood collection, testing, processing and distribution ensuring safe blood for medical procedures. Operates blood banks collecting blood from voluntary donors. Screens donated blood for HIV, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, syphilis and other infections. Processes blood into components (red cells, platelets, plasma). Distributes safe blood to hospitals nationwide. Promotes voluntary non-remunerated blood donation. Conducts blood donor recruitment and retention programs. Ensures blood safety through quality assurance. Operates National Blood Transfusion Service guidelines. Addresses blood shortages especially during emergencies. Collaborates with hospitals, blood banks and donor organizations. Addresses challenges from inadequate voluntary donation (many patients rely on family replacement donors), limited blood banks and cultural barriers. Safe blood transfusion critical for surgeries, maternal health, trauma care and treating blood disorders including sickle cell anemia prevalent in Nigeria. Aims to achieve 100% voluntary blood donation and eliminate blood-borne infection transmission.

**Core Mandate:** To ensure safe blood supply, coordinate blood transfusion services, promote voluntary blood donation, screen blood for infections and distribute quality blood products nationwide.

(f) Test blood for malaria and other infectious diseases
(g) Process whole blood into components (red cells, platelets, plasma)
(h) Distribute safe blood and blood products to hospitals
(i) Ensure blood safety through quality assurance programs
(j) Operate National Blood Transfusion Service standards
(k) Address blood shortages during emergencies and disasters
(l) Maintain blood inventory and availability

(q) Monitor transfusion-transmitted infections
(r) Collaborate with hospitals on blood utilization
(s) Coordinate with WHO on blood safety standards
(t) Advance blood safety and availability ensuring adequate safe blood for surgeries, maternal care and treating blood disorders including sickle cell disease

mda_name: 596. NATIONAL BOARD FOR ARABIC AND ISLAMIC STUDIES (NBAIS)
mandate_description:
National Board for Arabic and Islamic Studies is federal regulatory agency overseeing Arabic and Islamic education. Headquartered in Nigeria, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Established to regulate, standardize and develop Arabic and Islamic education in Nigeria's educational system. Regulates Islamiyya schools, Arabic schools and Islamic education institutions. Develops curriculum for Arabic and Islamic studies. Sets standards for Arabic and Islamic teachers. Accredits Islamic education programs in schools. Conducts examinations for Arabic and Islamic studies students. Issues certificates for Quranic education and Arabic proficiency. Promotes integration of Islamiyya education with Western education. Develops teaching materials for Arabic and Islamic subjects. Trains teachers of Arabic and Islamic studies. Collaborates with Islamic universities and Arabic language centers. Addresses challenges from unregulated Almajiri system, standardization gaps and quality concerns. Serves Nigeria's large Muslim population (~50% of population) requiring quality Islamic education. Critical for Islamic education development, Arabic language promotion and integrating religious education with conventional schooling.

**Core Mandate:** To regulate Arabic and Islamic education, develop Islamic studies curriculum, set standards for Islamic schools, promote Arabic language and integrate religious education with conventional system.

(h) Promote integration of Islamiyya with Western education

(q) Coordinate with education ministries on Islamic curriculum

(s) Develop policies on Islamic education development
(t) Advance Islamic education quality, Arabic language promotion and integration of religious education serving Nigeria's Muslim population

National Board for Technical Education is apex federal regulatory body overseeing technical and vocational education. Headquartered in Kaduna, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Established to regulate polytechnics, monotechnics, technical colleges and vocational training institutions. Accredits academic programs in polytechnics ensuring quality standards. Develops curriculum for National Diploma and Higher National Diploma programs. Sets minimum academic standards for technical education. Conducts accreditation visits inspecting facilities, staffing and programs. Regulates Federal, State and Private polytechnics nationwide. Oversees technical colleges and vocational training centers. Develops competency-based training curricula. Promotes Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET). Issues guidelines for establishing polytechnics. Collaborates with industries on curriculum development and practical training. Addresses challenges from inadequate funding, poor facilities and TVET perception issues. HND-degree dichotomy limiting polytechnic graduates' career progression remains contentious. Critical for technical workforce development, skills training and polytechnic education regulation ensuring quality technical and vocational training.

**Core Mandate:** To regulate technical and vocational education, accredit polytechnic programs, set TVET standards, develop technical curricula and ensure quality technical education in Nigeria.

(b) Accredit academic programs in Federal, State and Private polytechnics

(t) Advance technical education quality and TVET development ensuring polytechnics produce skilled technicians and technologists for Nigeria's industrial and technological workforce

National Boundary Commission is federal agency managing Nigeria's international and interstate boundaries. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Office of the Secretary to Government of Federation. Established to delimit, demarcate and maintain Nigeria's boundaries preventing conflicts. Manages Nigeria's international boundaries with Benin, Niger, Chad and Cameroon spanning approximately 4,900 km. Delimits interstate boundaries between Nigeria's 36 states and FCT preventing boundary disputes. Conducts boundary demarcation and pillaring marking territorial limits. Resolves boundary disputes through arbitration and mediation. Manages Bakassi Peninsula handover to Cameroon following ICJ ruling. Conducts boundary surveys using GPS and mapping technologies. Maintains boundary documentation and maps. Addresses community conflicts arising from boundary uncertainties. Collaborates with neighboring countries on transboundary management. Prevents illegal boundary alterations and encroachments. Addresses challenges from porous borders, boundary-related community conflicts and limited resources for comprehensive demarcation. Critical for territorial integrity, preventing interstate conflicts and managing international relations with neighbors.

**Core Mandate:** To delimit and demarcate Nigeria's boundaries, resolve boundary disputes, maintain territorial integrity and manage international and interstate boundary relations.

National Broadcasting Commission is federal regulatory agency overseeing broadcasting industry and electronic media. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Information and Culture. Established by NBC Act to regulate, license and monitor radio and television broadcasting. Issues broadcasting licenses for radio and TV stations. Regulates broadcast content ensuring compliance with broadcast code. Monitors broadcast stations for regulatory compliance. Enforces broadcast standards and ethics. Addresses hate speech, incitement and inflammatory broadcasts. Regulates political broadcasts during elections. Enforces local content requirements promoting Nigerian programs. Issues sanctions including fines and license suspension for violations. Promotes diversity in broadcasting and media pluralism. Regulates advertising content and commercial broadcasting. Manages broadcast spectrum allocation. Addresses challenges from digital broadcasting transition, fake news, regulatory independence concerns and constitutional free speech debates. Has sanctioned stations for broadcast code violations generating controversies. Critical for broadcast industry regulation, content standards and balancing press freedom with responsible broadcasting.

National Bureau of Statistics is federal agency collecting, analyzing and disseminating statistical data for national planning. Headquartered in Abuja with offices nationwide, operating under National Planning Commission and Office of President. Established to provide reliable statistical information supporting evidence-based policymaking. Conducts population census determining Nigeria's population (last conducted 2006, next planned). Collects economic statistics including GDP, inflation, employment and trade data. Conducts household surveys on living standards, consumption and poverty. Produces labor force statistics and unemployment data. Conducts agricultural surveys on crop production and livestock. Collects health statistics and demographic data. Produces education statistics on enrollment and literacy. Conducts business and industrial surveys. Maintains national statistical databases and indicators. Collaborates with ministries, states and international statistical organizations. Addresses challenges from data quality concerns, limited funding and delayed census (2006 census outdated). Nigeria's population estimates vary (180-220 million) due to census delays. Critical for development planning, resource allocation and evidence-based governance requiring accurate statistical data.

(t) Advance evidence-based governance providing accurate reliable statistics supporting national planning, resource allocation and development monitoring despite census delays and data challenges

mda_name: 601. NATIONAL BUSINESS AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION BOARD (NABTEB)
mandate_description:
National Business and Technical Education Board is federal examination body conducting technical and business education examinations. National Iron Ore Mining Project Itakpe is federal iron ore mining operation providing raw materials for steel production. Located in Itakpe, Kogi State, operating under Federal Ministry of Mines and Steel Development. Established as integrated mining project feeding Ajaokuta Steel Company with iron ore. Itakpe hosts significant iron ore deposits (estimated 200+ million tons). Conducts iron ore mining extraction operations. Processes iron ore concentrating and beneficiating ore. Produces iron ore pellets for steel making. Supplies iron ore to Ajaokuta Steel Company (non-functional). Operates mining infrastructure including crushers and concentrators. Maintains ore handling facilities. Conducts geological surveys and ore reserve assessment. Collaborates with Ajaokuta Steel Project on iron ore supply. Faces challenges from Ajaokuta Steel's non-operational status eliminating main customer, limited alternative markets and infrastructure constraints. Itakpe-Ajaokuta railway constructed for ore transportation but underutilized. Project represents Nigeria's steel industry ambitions - iron ore, steel plant, but both underperforming. Critical for steel sector development, mineral exploitation and providing raw materials for industrialization if steel sector revived.

National Judicial Council is constitutionally established body overseeing judicial administration and appointments. Located in Abuja, operating under 1999 Constitution as independent judicial authority. Established to ensure judicial independence, recommend judicial appointments and discipline judges. Recommends judicial appointments to President including Supreme Court, Court of Appeal and Federal High Court judges. Recommends Chief Justice of Nigeria and heads of courts. Disciplines judges for misconduct through investigation and sanctions. Addresses judicial corruption and ethical violations. Suspends or removes judges found guilty of misconduct. Coordinates administration of federal courts. Manages judiciary budgets and resources. Promotes judicial independence from executive interference. Addresses delays in justice delivery and case backlog. Develops judicial policies and practice directions. Conducts judicial education and training. Collaborates with state judicial service commissions. Faces challenges from judicial corruption perceptions, delayed appointments, underfunding and executive-judiciary tensions. Judicial independence critical for rule of law and democracy. NJC independence sometimes questioned during political judicial appointments. National Library of Nigeria is federal institution serving as repository of Nigerian published materials and national bibliographic center. Headquartered in Abuja with branches nationwide, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Established to collect, preserve and provide access to Nigeria's documentary heritage. Serves as legal deposit library receiving copies of all Nigerian publications. Maintains comprehensive collection of Nigerian books, journals and publications. Preserves Nigeria's documentary heritage and intellectual output. Operates National Bibliographic Center creating national bibliography. Provides library and information services to researchers and public. Maintains special collections including rare books and manuscripts. Digitizes Nigerian publications for preservation and access. Provides reference and research support services. Promotes reading culture and library use. Operates branch libraries across Nigeria. Collaborates with state and university libraries. Provides professional development for librarians. Addresses challenges from inadequate funding, limited acquisitions, infrastructure constraints and digitization needs. National Mathematical Centre is federal research institution conducting mathematical research and promoting mathematics education. Located in Sheda, Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Established to advance mathematical sciences, conduct research and build Nigeria's mathematical capacity. National Obstetric Fistula Centre Bauchi is specialized federal hospital treating obstetric fistula in northeastern Nigeria. Located in Bauchi, Bauchi State, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Part of network of fistula centers addressing maternal health complications. Obstetric fistula results from prolonged obstructed labor causing devastating injury - hole between birth canal and bladder/rectum leading to constant urine/feces leakage. Provides free surgical repair of vesico-vaginal fistula (VVF) and recto-vaginal fistula (RVF). Conducts complex fistula surgeries including revision repairs. Offers comprehensive fistula care including pre-operative counseling and post-operative rehabilitation. Provides psychosocial support addressing trauma, stigma and social exclusion. Supports social reintegration for fistula survivors. Trains surgeons on fistula repair techniques. Conducts outreach programs identifying fistula cases in communities. Promotes safe childbirth and emergency obstetric care preventing fistula. Collaborates with UNFPA, Fistula Foundation and partners. Northeastern Nigeria has high fistula prevalence from early marriage, home deliveries and limited obstetric care access. Serves Bauchi, Gombe, Yobe and surrounding states. National Obstetric Fistula Centre Abakaliki is specialized federal hospital treating obstetric fistula in southeastern Nigeria. Located in Abakaliki, Ebonyi State, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Part of national network of fistula treatment centers. mda_name: 659. NATIONAL OFFICE FOR TECHNOLOGY ACQUISITION AND PROMOTION (NOTAP)
mandate_description:
National Office for Technology Acquisition and Promotion is federal agency regulating technology transfer and promoting technology development. Located in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Established to regulate technology transfer agreements, promote local technology development and reduce technology dependence. Registers and approves technology transfer agreements between Nigerian companies and foreign technology providers. Regulates foreign technical assistance and technology licensing. Promotes technology acquisition on favorable terms protecting Nigerian interests. Prevents exploitative technology transfer contracts. Monitors technology payments and royalties to foreign entities. Promotes local technology development and innovation. Encourages technology adaptation and reverse engineering. Supports indigenous technology capacity building. Collaborates with industries on technology development. Addresses technology dependence - Nigeria imports most technologies. Promotes local content in technology contracts. Addresses challenges from weak negotiating capacity, limited local technology base and foreign technology dominance. Technology transfer critical for industrialization but must benefit Nigeria not just enrich foreign firms. Critical for technology development, reducing dependence and ensuring technology transfer supports Nigeria's industrial and technological advancement.

mda_name: 660. NATIONAL OIL SPILL DETECTION AND RESPONSE AGENCY (NOSDRA)
mandate_description:
National Oil Spill Detection and Response Agency is federal regulatory agency preventing and responding to oil spills in Nigeria's oil-producing regions. Headquartered in Abuja with offices in Niger Delta, operating under Federal Ministry of Environment. Established to regulate oil industry environmental compliance, detect oil spills and coordinate spill response. Detects and monitors oil spills in Niger Delta and offshore. Coordinates oil spill response and cleanup operations. Enforces oil industry environmental regulations (NESREA handles non-oil sectors). Ensures oil companies conduct Environmental Impact Assessments. Monitors pipeline integrity and leak detection systems. Imposes sanctions on companies causing oil spills. Coordinates oil spill compensation for affected communities. Promotes oil spill prevention and preparedness. Operates National Oil Spill Contingency Plan. Collaborates with oil companies on spill response. Addresses Niger Delta environmental degradation from decades of oil pollution - Ogoniland still severely contaminated despite cleanup promises. UNEP 2011 report documented extensive oil pollution requiring billions for remediation. Faces challenges from oil theft/bunkering causing spills, inadequate cleanup, limited enforcement capacity and industry non-compliance. Critical for environmental protection, Niger Delta cleanup and holding oil companies accountable for pollution.

**Core Mandate:** To detect and respond to oil spills, regulate oil industry environmental compliance, coordinate spill cleanup, protect Niger Delta environment and ensure oil pollution accountability.

National Open University of Nigeria is federal open and distance learning university providing flexible tertiary education. Headquartered in Abuja with study centers nationwide, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Established in 1983, closed in 1984, re-established in 2002 as Nigeria's only single-mode open and distance learning (ODL) university. Provides undergraduate and postgraduate degree programs through distance learning. Admits working adults, professionals and non-traditional students. Offers flexible learning accommodating work schedules. Provides programs in arts, sciences, education, management sciences, law, agriculture and engineering. Operates study centers across Nigeria for student support. Delivers courses through print materials, online platforms and multimedia. Conducts virtual lectures and e-learning. Operates facilitation centers for practical sessions and examinations. Admits over 500,000 students making it Africa's largest single-mode ODL university. Provides affordable tertiary education for those unable to attend conventional universities. Promotes lifelong learning and continuing education. National Orthopaedic Hospital Dala Kano is specialized federal orthopedic and trauma hospital. Located in Dala, Kano State (Nigeria's second most populous state), operating under Federal Ministry of Health. National Parks Headquarters is federal coordinating body overseeing Nigeria's national parks system. Operating under Federal Ministry of Environment. National Pension Commission is federal regulatory agency overseeing Nigeria's Contributory Pension Scheme. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Pension Reform Act 2014. Established to regulate pension industry, protect pension fund assets and ensure retirement income security. Regulates Contributory Pension Scheme for public and private sector workers. Approves pension fund investments ensuring safety and returns. Addresses employer non-remittance of pension deductions. Promotes pension coverage expansion. Regulates Micro Pension Plan for informal sector workers. Collaborates with NSITF on workplace pensions. Pension assets exceed N15 trillion managed by PFAs. Faces challenges from employer non-compliance (many employers deduct but don't remit), limited informal sector coverage and investment returns concerns. Pension reform transformed Nigeria from pay-as-you-go to funded system. Critical for retirement security, pension assets protection and ensuring workers have income in old age.

mda_name: 673. NATIONAL POSTGRADUATE MEDICAL COLLEGE OF NIGERIA (NPMCN)
mandate_description:
National Postgraduate Medical College of Nigeria is premier medical institution conducting postgraduate medical education and specialist training. Located in Ijanikin, Lagos State, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established to train medical specialists through Fellowship programs. Conducts Fellowship examinations for medical specialization. Trains specialists through Fellowship of National Postgraduate Medical College (FNPMC) programs. Accredits hospitals as training centers for residency programs. Provides specialist training in internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, obstetrics/gynecology and other specialties. Conducts Part 1 and Part 2 Fellowship examinations. Issues Fellowship certificates to qualified specialist doctors. Promotes continuous medical education for specialists. Collaborates with West African College of Surgeons (WACS) and West African College of Physicians. Addresses specialist doctor shortages - Nigeria has critical specialist gaps. Many doctors pursue postgraduate training abroad (UK, US, Canada) contributing to brain drain. NPMCN provides local alternative to foreign postgraduate medical training. Faces challenges from limited training facilities, examination capacity and specialist trainer shortages. Critical for specialist medical workforce development, reducing foreign medical training dependence and addressing Nigeria's specialist doctor shortage.

mda_name: 674. NATIONAL POWER TRAINING INSTITUTE OF NIGERIA (NAPTIN)
mandate_description:
National Power Training Institute of Nigeria is federal training institution developing power sector workforce. Operating under Federal Ministry of Power. Established to train engineers, technicians and professionals for electricity generation, transmission and distribution. Provides training for power plant operators and maintenance engineers. Trains electrical engineers on power systems and grid management. Offers programs in power generation technologies. Trains on transmission infrastructure and high-voltage systems. Provides distribution network management training. Conducts renewable energy training (solar, wind, hydro). Trains on smart grid and modern power technologies. Offers metering and billing systems training. Provides power sector safety and occupational health training. Conducts continuing education for power sector workers. Collaborates with electricity generation companies (GenCos), transmission company (TCN) and distribution companies (DisCos). Addresses Nigeria's power crisis - chronic electricity shortages, grid collapses, limited generation capacity (~4,000-5,000 MW for 200M+ population). Power sector requires skilled workforce for improvement. Faces challenges from outdated training equipment and rapidly evolving power technologies. Critical for power sector capacity building, skilled workforce development and supporting electricity sector improvement.

mda_name: 675. NATIONAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE DEVELOPMENT AGENCY (NPHCDA)
mandate_description:
National Primary Health Care Development Agency is federal agency coordinating primary healthcare delivery, immunization and basic health services. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established to strengthen primary healthcare system providing basic healthcare to communities. Coordinates National Primary Health Care System across 36 states. Manages routine immunization programs vaccinating children against preventable diseases. Conducts polio eradication campaigns - Nigeria declared polio-free 2020 after decades of efforts. Coordinates COVID-19 vaccination rollout nationwide. Provides maternal and child health services. Operates Midwives Service Scheme deploying midwives to rural areas. Promotes skilled birth attendance and antenatal care. Supports malaria prevention and treatment programs. Provides family planning and reproductive health services. Coordinates nutrition programs addressing malnutrition. Operates community health insurance schemes. Strengthens Primary Health Care Centers (PHCs) infrastructure. Collaborates with WHO, UNICEF, Gavi on immunization. Faces challenges from inadequate PHC facilities (many non-functional), vaccine cold chain gaps, health worker shortages in rural areas and limited funding. PHC critical for universal health coverage but severely underfunded. Critical for basic healthcare, immunization, maternal health and community health services.

mda_name: 678. NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR CHEMICAL TECHNOLOGY (NARICT), ZARIA

mda_name: 679. NATIONAL ROOT CROPS RESEARCH INSTITUTE (NRCRI), UMUDIKE
mandate_description:
National Root Crops Research Institute is federal agricultural research institution conducting research on root and tuber crops. Located in Umudike, Abia State in southeastern Nigeria, operating under Agricultural Research Council of Nigeria and Federal Ministry of Agriculture. Established to develop improved varieties and production technologies for cassava, yam, sweet potato, cocoyam and other root crops. Conducts cassava research developing high-yielding disease-resistant varieties. Researches yam production, storage and processing technologies. Develops sweet potato varieties with improved nutrition. Conducts cocoyam research addressing taro leaf blight. Researches ginger, turmeric and other root crops. Develops virus-resistant and pest-resistant root crop varieties. Researches root crop processing and value addition. Develops improved storage technologies reducing post-harvest losses. Multiplies and distributes improved planting materials. Collaborates with IITA on cassava and root crops research. Root crops critical for food security - cassava staple for millions, yam culturally important. Nigeria world's largest cassava producer but yields low. Cassava for industrial starch, ethanol, animal feed. Critical for food security, industrial raw materials and root crops sector development.

National Rural Electrification Agency is federal agency expanding electricity access to rural and underserved areas. Operating under Federal Ministry of Power. Develops mini-grids for rural communities using solar and hybrid systems. Promotes solar home systems for off-grid households. Constructs grid extension to unelectrified communities. Develops renewable energy solutions (solar, biomass, small hydro). Operates Nigeria Electrification Project with World Bank support. Provides electricity to rural health centers and schools. Supports productive use of electricity in agriculture and SMEs. Collaborates with private sector on mini-grid development. Implements environmental remediation projects addressing oil pollution. Provides scholarships for Niger Delta students. Supports skills acquisition and youth empowerment. Develops electricity and water supply projects. Addresses coastal erosion devastating communities. Builds healthcare centers and equips hospitals. Constructs classrooms and educational facilities. Funds percentage of oil revenues for development. Addresses militancy, restiveness and youth unemployment. Collaborates with oil companies on corporate social responsibility. Faces massive challenges - corruption scandals, contract inflation, project abandonment, forensic audit revealing widespread fraud, political interference, limited impact despite huge budgets. NDDC represents Niger Delta development hopes vs. corruption reality. Critical for regional development, peace and addressing oil-producing region's marginalization despite enormous challenges.

**Core Mandate:** To develop Niger Delta region, provide infrastructure, address environmental degradation, implement remediation, empower youth and promote peace in oil-producing states.

**Statutory Functions:**
(a) Develop Niger Delta region across nine oil-producing states
(b) Provide infrastructure including roads, bridges and electricity
(c) Build healthcare facilities and equip hospitals in Niger Delta
(d) Construct schools, classrooms and educational infrastructure
(e) Implement environmental remediation addressing oil pollution
(f) Address Ogoniland environmental devastation
(g) Provide scholarships for Niger Delta students
(h) Support skills acquisition and vocational training
(i) Empower youth reducing militancy and restiveness
(j) Develop water supply and sanitation infrastructure
(k) Address coastal erosion devastating Delta communities
(l) Build jetties and riverine transportation infrastructure
(m) Support agriculture and fisheries development
(n) Receive percentage of oil revenues for development
(o) Collaborate with oil companies on CSR projects
(p) Address youth unemployment fueling militancy
(q) Promote peace and conflict resolution
(r) Combat corruption and contract fraud
(s) Implement forensic audit recommendations addressing fraud
(t) Advance Niger Delta development addressing decades of oil-driven environmental degradation and marginalization despite massive corruption scandals and limited impact

mda_name: 704. NIGER DELTA RIVER BASIN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (NDRBDA)
mandate_description:
Niger Delta River Basin Development Authority is federal agency managing water resources and irrigation in Niger Delta region. Operating under Federal Ministry of Water Resources as one of Nigeria's 12 River Basin Development Authorities. Covers oil-producing Niger Delta states managing complex riverine and coastal water systems. Develops irrigation schemes in Niger Delta swamps and floodplains. Manages water resources in Rivers, Bayelsa and Delta States. Addresses flooding from river systems and tidal influences. Develops water supply for communities. Supports fish farming in Niger Delta waterways. Manages freshwater swamps for agriculture. Provides drainage for waterlogged agricultural lands. Collaborates with NDDC on water infrastructure. Faces unique challenges from tidal influences, oil pollution affecting waterways, coastal erosion, seasonal flooding and saltwater intrusion into freshwater systems. Niger Delta's complex hydrology - rivers, creeks, mangroves, swamps. Agriculture constrained by waterlogging and flooding. Critical for water management, irrigation development and agricultural support in oil-dominated Niger Delta economy.

**Core Mandate:** To manage Niger Delta water resources, develop irrigation, provide flood control, support agriculture and address unique riverine challenges in oil-producing region.

**Statutory Functions:**
(a) Manage water resources in Niger Delta region
(b) Develop irrigation schemes in swamps and floodplains
(c) Manage water resources in Rivers, Bayelsa and Delta States
(d) Address flooding from river systems and tidal influences
(e) Provide flood control infrastructure
(f) Develop water supply for Delta communities
(g) Support fish farming in rivers, creeks and waterways
(h) Manage freshwater swamps for agricultural use
(i) Provide drainage for waterlogged agricultural lands
(j) Address coastal flooding and erosion
(k) Manage saltwater intrusion into freshwater systems
(l) Develop fadama irrigation in Delta floodplains
(m) Support rice, cassava and vegetable production through irrigation
(n) Collaborate with NDDC on water infrastructure projects
(o) Address oil pollution affecting water quality
(p) Manage environmental impacts on water systems
(q) Support riverine transportation and fisheries
(r) Conduct hydrological studies on Delta water systems
(s) Manage complex tidal and freshwater interactions
(t) Advance water management and agricultural development in Niger Delta addressing unique challenges from oil pollution, flooding and complex riverine hydrology

Nigeria Agricultural Quarantine Service is federal regulatory agency preventing entry and spread of plant and animal pests and diseases. Operating under Federal Ministry of Agriculture. Established to protect Nigerian agriculture from exotic pests, diseases and invasive species. Conducts quarantine inspections at borders, airports and seaports. Prevents entry of plant pests and diseases from imported crops. Inspects animal imports for diseases. Issues phytosanitary certificates for agricultural exports. Regulates importation of plants, seeds and plant products. Prevents entry of invasive species threatening agriculture. Conducts fumigation and treatment of imported goods. Monitors international pest outbreaks preventing entry to Nigeria. Enforces international phytosanitary standards. Collaborates with customs on agricultural imports inspection. Addresses challenges from porous borders allowing smuggled agricultural products, limited inspection capacity and emerging pest threats. Fall armyworm outbreak demonstrated vulnerability - devastating maize crops. Tomato Ebola virus affected tomato production. Critical for agricultural biosecurity, protecting crops/livestock from foreign pests and ensuring safe agricultural trade.

**Core Mandate:** To prevent entry of agricultural pests and diseases, conduct quarantine inspections, protect Nigerian agriculture, ensure biosecurity and regulate agricultural imports/exports.

**Statutory Functions:**
(a) Prevent entry and spread of plant pests and diseases
(b) Conduct quarantine inspections at borders, airports and seaports
(c) Inspect imported crops, seeds and plant materials
(d) Prevent animal disease entry from imported livestock
(e) Issue phytosanitary certificates for agricultural exports
(f) Regulate importation of plants and plant products
(g) Prevent entry of invasive species threatening agriculture
(h) Conduct fumigation and treatment of infested imports
(i) Monitor international pest and disease outbreaks
(j) Prevent fall armyworm and exotic pest entry
(k) Enforce International Plant Protection Convention standards
(l) Collaborate with customs on agricultural imports
(m) Inspect baggage for prohibited agricultural products
(n) Address smuggled agricultural products through porous borders
(o) Conduct pest risk analysis for new crops
(p) Quarantine infected materials preventing disease spread
(q) Train quarantine inspectors and officers
(r) Provide agricultural biosecurity advisory services
(s) Monitor emerging pest and disease threats
(t) Advance agricultural biosecurity protecting crops and livestock from exotic pests and diseases ensuring safe agricultural trade

Nigeria Airspace Management Agency is federal agency managing Nigerian airspace and providing air traffic control services. Operating under Federal Ministry of Aviation. Established to manage airspace, provide air navigation services and ensure aviation safety. Provides air traffic control services at Nigerian airports. Manages Nigerian airspace and flight information regions. Ensures aircraft separation and collision avoidance. Operates control towers at major airports (Lagos, Abuja, Kano, Port Harcourt). Provides approach and departure control services. Operates area control centers managing en-route traffic. Maintains air navigation equipment and radar systems. Provides aeronautical information and weather services. Coordinates with regional air navigation service providers. Ensures compliance with ICAO international standards. Addresses air traffic delays and congestion especially Lagos airspace. Collaborates with NCAA on aviation safety. Faces challenges from aging equipment, radar coverage gaps, power supply disruptions and capacity constraints. Lagos airspace among world's busiest requiring modern systems. Critical for aviation safety, airspace management and preventing mid-air collisions through professional air traffic control.

**Core Mandate:** To manage Nigerian airspace, provide air traffic control, ensure aircraft separation, operate navigation systems and guarantee aviation safety through airspace management.

(e) Provide approach and departure control services
(f) Operate area control centers managing en-route air traffic
(g) Maintain air navigation equipment and systems
(h) Operate radar systems for aircraft tracking

(j) Disseminate meteorological information to pilots
(k) Coordinate with regional air navigation providers

(m) Address air traffic delays and airspace congestion
(n) Manage Lagos airspace (among world's busiest)
(o) Collaborate with NCAA on aviation safety
(p) Operate communications systems for air traffic
(q) Provide flight planning and briefing services
(r) Manage emergency and distress situations
(s) Address aging equipment and radar coverage gaps
(t) Advance aviation safety through professional airspace management preventing collisions ensuring efficient air traffic flow despite equipment and capacity challenges

mda_name: 707. NIGERIA ATOMIC ENERGY COMMISSION (NAEC) AND CENTRES
mandate_description:
Nigeria Atomic Energy Commission is federal agency developing peaceful nuclear energy applications and radiation safety. Operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Established to develop nuclear science, radiation technology and prepare for nuclear power. Conducts nuclear science research and development. Promotes peaceful uses of nuclear energy. Develops radiation technology applications for medicine, agriculture and industry. Operates research reactors (miniature neutron source reactor). Provides radiation safety and nuclear security services. Regulates radioactive materials and radiation sources. Trains nuclear scientists and radiation protection officers. Develops nuclear medicine and radiotherapy applications. Promotes nuclear agriculture using irradiation and isotopes. Researches nuclear power technology. Prepares Nigeria for potential nuclear power plants. Collaborates with IAEA on nuclear technology. Operates Centre for Energy Research and Training (CERT) Zaria. Addresses challenges from public nuclear fears, limited funding, nuclear technology restrictions and skills gaps. Nigeria exploring nuclear power for electricity generation. Critical for nuclear science development, radiation applications and building nuclear technology capacity for potential nuclear energy program.

(b) Conduct nuclear science research and development
(c) Promote radiation technology applications in medicine, agriculture and industry
(d) Operate research reactors and nuclear facilities
(e) Provide radiation safety and protection services
(f) Regulate radioactive materials and radiation sources
(g) Ensure nuclear security and safeguards
(h) Train nuclear scientists and radiation protection officers

(j) Promote nuclear agriculture using irradiation
(k) Use isotopes and radiation for pest control
(l) Research nuclear power technology
(m) Prepare Nigeria for potential nuclear power plants
(n) Collaborate with IAEA on nuclear technology transfer

(p) Monitor radiation exposure and environmental radioactivity
(q) Develop nuclear analytical techniques
(r) Address public concerns about nuclear safety
(s) Build nuclear technology capacity and skills
(t) Advance nuclear science and radiation technology developing peaceful applications preparing for nuclear power addressing energy crisis despite public fears and technology restrictions

mda_name: 708. NIGERIA CENTRE FOR DISEASE CONTROL (NCDC), ABUJA
mandate_description:
Nigeria Centre for Disease Control is federal public health agency coordinating disease surveillance, outbreak response and epidemic control. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established 2011, gained prominence during COVID-19 pandemic. Coordinates disease surveillance and outbreak detection nationwide. Responds to disease outbreaks and epidemics. Managed Nigeria's COVID-19 response - testing, contact tracing, isolation centers. Addresses Lassa fever annual outbreaks (endemic in southern Nigeria). Responds to cholera outbreaks during rainy seasons. Manages yellow fever outbreak responses. Coordinates monkeypox and other emerging infectious diseases. Operates National Reference Laboratory. Provides laboratory diagnosis for infectious diseases. Conducts epidemiological investigations. Trains public health professionals on outbreak response. Issues public health advisories and guidelines. Collaborates with WHO, Africa CDC and international health agencies. Operates Emergency Operations Centre. Faces challenges from limited laboratory capacity, funding constraints and health system weaknesses. NCDC leadership during COVID-19 demonstrated importance. Critical for epidemic preparedness, outbreak response and protecting Nigerians from infectious disease threats.

**Core Mandate:** To coordinate disease surveillance and outbreak response, manage epidemics, conduct laboratory diagnosis, provide public health leadership and protect Nigeria from infectious diseases.

(l) Develop disease surveillance systems
(m) Issue public health advisories and prevention guidelines
(n) Operate Emergency Operations Centre coordinating responses
(o) Collaborate with WHO on International Health Regulations
(p) Coordinate with Africa CDC on continental health security
(q) Manage infection prevention and control programs
(r) Conduct research on infectious diseases
(s) Address antimicrobial resistance surveillance
(t) Advance epidemic preparedness and response protecting Nigerians from infectious disease threats through surveillance, laboratory diagnosis and outbreak coordination

Nigeria Christian Pilgrims Commission is federal agency organizing and regulating Christian pilgrimage to Holy Land. Operating under Office of President. Established to coordinate Nigerian Christians' pilgrimage to Jerusalem, Rome and other holy sites. Organizes annual Christian pilgrimage to Israel/Holy Land. Coordinates pilgrimages to Rome, Vatican and other Christian sites. Registers Christian pilgrims from denominations nationwide. Negotiates with Israeli authorities on pilgrimage arrangements. Airlifts pilgrims to Israel and back. Provides accommodation and welfare services in Jerusalem. Regulates Christian tour operators and pilgrimage agents. Conducts pre-departure orientation for pilgrims. Ensures pilgrims' safety and security abroad. Regulates pilgrimage costs preventing exploitation. Collaborates with Israeli tourism authorities. Addresses challenges from high costs, limited quotas, interfaith sensitivities (parallel to NAHCON for Muslims) and pilgrim welfare concerns. Thousands of Nigerian Christians perform Holy Land pilgrimage annually. Pilgrimage represents religious devotion, tourism and international relations. Critical for religious fulfillment, pilgrim protection and managing Christian pilgrimage operations.

(t) Advance religious pilgrimage managing thousands of Nigerian Christians visiting Holy Land ensuring safety, affordability and spiritual fulfillment

Nigeria Communications Satellite Limited is federal agency operating communications satellites for telecommunications and broadcasting. Operating under Federal Ministry of Communications. Established to provide satellite communications infrastructure and broadcast services. Operates NigComSat satellites providing communications capacity. Provides satellite capacity for telecommunications companies. Supports broadcasting via satellite transmissions. Offers internet connectivity through satellite. Provides VSAT services for remote areas. Supports government communications infrastructure. Offers satellite bandwidth for commercial clients. Addresses digital divide through satellite connectivity. Provides disaster recovery communications backup. Supports border surveillance and security communications. Collaborates with NASRDA on satellite operations. Nigeria launched first communication satellite NigComSat-1 (2007) which failed 2008. NigComSat-1R launched 2011 as replacement. Faces challenges from satellite failures, commercial viability, competition from fiber optics and underutilization. Satellite communications declining with terrestrial alternatives. Critical for telecommunications infrastructure, remote connectivity and providing satellite services despite commercial challenges.

(q) Compete with fiber optic and terrestrial alternatives
(r) Ensure satellite communications security
(s) Develop satellite communications market
(t) Advance telecommunications infrastructure through satellite operations providing connectivity despite commercial viability challenges and competition from terrestrial networks

Nigeria Correctional Service is federal paramilitary agency managing prisons, correctional facilities and inmate rehabilitation. Operating under Federal Ministry of Interior. Formerly Nigerian Prisons Service renamed 2019 emphasizing corrections over punishment. Operates federal prisons and correctional facilities nationwide. Detains convicted criminals and awaiting trial inmates. Provides rehabilitation and reformation programs for inmates. Operates skills acquisition training for prisoners. Provides vocational education and literacy programs. Ensures humane treatment and prisoners' rights. Operates maximum security prisons for dangerous criminals. Manages remand centers for awaiting trial detainees. Addresses prison congestion - facilities overcrowded at 200-300% capacity. Awaiting trial detainees constitute 70%+ of prison population. Provides healthcare services for inmates. Ensures prison security preventing escapes. Collaborates with judiciary on speedy trials. Faces massive challenges - overcrowding, inhumane conditions, inadequate funding, awaiting trial backlog, insufficient rehabilitation programs. Prison reforms urgent - conditions criticized by rights groups. Critical for criminal justice, inmate rehabilitation and detention management despite severe overcrowding and systemic challenges.

(s) Address inhumane conditions criticized by rights organizations
(t) Advance criminal justice and inmate rehabilitation managing correctional facilities despite severe overcrowding, awaiting trial backlog and urgent need for reforms

Nigeria Electricity Liability Management Limited is federal agency managing legacy debts and liabilities from power sector privatization. Operating under Federal Ministry of Power. Established to manage stranded costs and financial liabilities from unbundling of former Power Holding Company of Nigeria (PHCN). Manages legacy debts from defunct PHCN. Addresses stranded assets and liabilities post-privatization. Manages pension liabilities for former PHCN workers. Settles outstanding obligations to contractors and suppliers. Addresses electricity sector financial legacy issues. Manages gas supply debts and obligations. Coordinates resolution of pre-privatization liabilities. Prevents legacy debts constraining privatized companies. Collaborates with Generation Companies and Distribution Companies. Addresses financial barriers to power sector reform. Manages severance payments for disengaged workers. Power sector privatization 2013 left enormous legacy debts. NELMCO prevents these from undermining sector performance. Faces challenges from enormous debt quantum, limited resources and complex liability structures. Critical for power sector financial sustainability, enabling privatized entities focus on operations and preventing legacy liabilities sabotaging electricity reform.

(q) Enable privatized entities focus on operations not legacy debts
(r) Address financial barriers to power sector reform
(s) Manage enormous debt quantum from decades of sector neglect
(t) Advance power sector financial sustainability managing PHCN legacy preventing inherited debts undermining electricity reform and privatization

Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative is independent federal agency promoting transparency and accountability in oil, gas and mining sectors. Operating under Presidency. Established 2007 as Nigeria's implementing body for global Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI). Conducts audits of oil, gas and mining revenues. Promotes transparency in extractive industries payments. Publishes reconciliation reports on government oil revenues. Monitors oil companies' payments to government. Tracks mining sector revenues and payments. Addresses revenue leakages and underpayments. Promotes accountability in petroleum sector management. Publishes beneficial ownership information on oil companies. Conducts policy advocacy on extractive industries governance. Engages civil society and media on transparency. Collaborates with NNPC, FIRS and revenue agencies. Nigeria pioneer EITI implementer globally. NEITI reports exposed billions in revenue losses, unremitted funds. Faces challenges from limited enforcement powers (can only recommend), political interference and industry resistance. NEITI exposes but cannot compel action. Critical for transparency, accountability and preventing resource curse through extractive industries oversight despite limited enforcement authority.

(r) Advocate for reforms in petroleum fiscal regime
(s) Promote Petroleum Industry Act transparency provisions
(t) Advance extractive industries accountability through audits and transparency despite limited enforcement powers exposing revenue leakages and promoting petroleum sector reforms

Nigeria Football Federation is governing body for football (soccer) in Nigeria. Operating under Federal Ministry of Youth and Sports Development. Established to regulate football, manage national teams and develop Nigerian football. Governs football at all levels - grassroots to professional. Manages Super Eagles (men's national team). Oversees Super Falcons (women's national team) - most successful African women's team. Manages youth national teams (Flying Eagles, Golden Eaglets). Regulates Nigeria Professional Football League. Organizes domestic cup competitions. Coordinates with FIFA and CAF on international football. Qualifies Nigeria for World Cup and Africa Cup of Nations. Develops grassroots football and talent identification. Regulates professional football clubs. Licenses coaches and referees. Addresses football governance and administration challenges. (t) Advance Nigerian football managing national teams (AFCON winners 1980, 1994, 2013) despite governance crises, government interference and performance decline

Nigeria Hydrological Services Agency is federal agency monitoring water resources, river flows and flood forecasting. Operating under Federal Ministry of Water Resources. Established to provide hydrological data, flood early warning and water resources information. Monitors river flows and water levels nationwide. Operates hydrological stations on major rivers (Niger, Benue, others). Provides flood forecasting and early warning. Issues flood alerts to NEMA and state governments. Monitors dam water levels and releases. Provides hydrological data for water resources planning. Conducts water resources assessment. Monitors groundwater levels and aquifer recharge. Collaborates with meteorological services on rainfall data. Operates real-time monitoring systems. Provides data for irrigation and hydropower planning. Addresses annual flooding - Nigeria experiences devastating floods (2012: 2M displaced, 2022: 4M+ affected). Cameroon's Lagdo Dam releases exacerbate Nigerian flooding. NIHSA provides early warnings enabling evacuation. Faces challenges from limited monitoring stations, equipment maintenance and data gaps. Improved flood forecasting could save lives and property. Nigeria Immigration Service is federal paramilitary agency controlling borders, managing immigration and issuing passports. Operating under Federal Ministry of Interior. Established to regulate entry/exit, prevent illegal immigration and control Nigerian borders. Controls Nigerian borders at land, air and sea entry points. Issues Nigerian passports (standard and e-passport). Processes visa applications for foreigners visiting Nigeria. Prevents illegal immigration and border infiltration. mda_name: 717. NIGERIA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE LABORATORY TECHNOLOGY (NISLT), IBADAN
mandate_description:
Nigeria Institute of Science Laboratory Technology is federal training institution for laboratory scientists and technicians. Located in Ibadan, Oyo State, operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Established to train laboratory technologists and technicians for science, health and industry. Provides diploma and certificate programs in laboratory technology. Trains medical laboratory technicians for healthcare facilities. Provides chemical laboratory technology training for industries. Trains biological sciences laboratory technicians. Offers physics and engineering laboratory technology programs. Provides practical laboratory skills and techniques training. Trains on laboratory equipment operation and maintenance. Offers continuing education for laboratory personnel. Supports quality control and laboratory standards. Provides training for research institute laboratory staff. Collaborates with hospitals, universities and industries. Addresses laboratory personnel shortages especially in rural health facilities. Laboratory technicians critical for diagnostics, research and quality control. Faces challenges from equipment needs, limited practical facilities and competing with universities. Critical for laboratory workforce development, supporting healthcare diagnostics, research and industrial quality control.

**Core Mandate:** To train laboratory technologists and technicians, provide laboratory technology education, develop laboratory workforce and support science, healthcare and industrial laboratories.

**Statutory Functions:**

mda_name: 719. NIGERIA INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED LEGAL STUDIES (NIALS)

mda_name: 720. NIGERIA INSTITUTE OF LEATHER AND SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY (NILEST)
mandate_description:
Nigeria Institute of Leather and Science Technology is federal training institution for leather technology and footwear manufacturing. Operating under Federal Ministry of Science and Technology. Offers shoemaking and footwear production programs. Provides leather quality control training. Supports leather industry workforce development. National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission is federal agency regulating public sector salaries, wages and remuneration. Operating under Federal Ministry of Finance. mda_name: 682. OFFICE OF THE NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISER (ONSA)
mandate_description:
Office of the National Security Adviser is apex national security coordination body advising President on security matters. Located in Abuja, operating directly under Presidency. National Security Adviser appointed by President coordinates Nigeria's security architecture. Advises President on national security policy and strategy. Coordinates security agencies (military, police, DSS, NIA, NSCDC). Develops national security strategy addressing terrorism, insurgency and threats. Coordinates counter-terrorism operations against Boko Haram and ISWAP. Oversees National Counter Terrorism Centre operations. Manages Multinational Joint Task Force (MNJTF) coordination. Coordinates intelligence sharing among security agencies. Addresses security challenges - Boko Haram insurgency (35,000+ deaths), northwestern banditry, kidnapping epidemic, farmer-herder conflicts, IPOB agitations, oil theft. Coordinates military operations in northeast, northwest and other theaters. Oversees defense procurement and security equipment acquisition. Manages security budgets and funding allocation. Collaborates with international security partners. Current NSA coordinates whole-of-government security response. Faces challenges from multiple simultaneous security crises, inter-agency coordination difficulties and resource constraints. Critical for national security coordination, strategic planning and managing Nigeria's complex multi-dimensional security threats.

National Social Investment Office manages federal social safety net programs for poor and vulnerable Nigerians. Operating under Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs. mda_name: 686. NATIONAL SPACE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCY (NASRDA)

mda_name: 689. NATIONAL STEEL RAW MATERIALS EXPLORATION AGENCY (NSRMEA), KADUNA

Conducts Teachers' Grade II to NCE upgrading. Provides in-service professional development for teachers. Operates Professional Diploma in Education (PDE) programs. Trains teachers in pedagogy and subject content. Provides special education teacher training. Conducts ICT training for teachers. Operates study centers nationwide for teacher support. National Universities Commission is apex federal regulatory body overseeing university education in Nigeria. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Established to regulate, accredit and ensure quality in Nigerian universities. Regulates Federal, State and Private universities (200+ universities total). Accredits university academic programs ensuring quality standards. Approves establishment of new universities. Addresses proliferation of universities - rapid growth from 15 universities (1985) to 200+ universities (2024). Monitors quality assurance in university education. Regulates staff-student ratios and lecturer qualifications. mda_name: 695. NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (NUST), ABUJA
mandate_description:
National University of Science and Technology Abuja is specialized federal university focusing on science, technology and innovation. Located in Abuja, FCT, operating under Federal Ministry of Education. Recently established as Nigeria's premier science and technology university. Focuses on science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM). Offers undergraduate programs in engineering, pure sciences and technology. Provides postgraduate programs in advanced scientific fields. Conducts cutting-edge research on science and technology. Develops innovation and entrepreneurship programs. Promotes applied sciences and technology commercialization. Operates modern laboratories and research facilities. Collaborates with industries on technology development. Trains scientists, engineers and technologists for 21st century. Promotes fourth industrial revolution technologies. Researches artificial intelligence, robotics and emerging technologies. Supports Nigeria's technology and innovation ecosystem. Addresses STEM skills gaps and technology deficit. Represents government commitment to science and technology education. Faces challenges from establishing new university infrastructure, attracting quality faculty and competing with established universities. Critical for STEM education advancement, technology workforce development and supporting Nigeria's science and technology ambitions.

National Veterinary Research Institute is premier federal institution conducting veterinary research and animal disease control. Located in Vom, Plateau State, operating under Federal Ministry of Agriculture. Established to conduct animal health research, produce vaccines and support livestock disease control. Conducts research on livestock diseases affecting cattle, sheep, goats and poultry. Produces veterinary vaccines for animal diseases. Develops diagnostic tests for animal diseases. Researches zoonotic diseases transmissible to humans. Conducts research on Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP). Studies Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) in small ruminants. Researches poultry diseases including Newcastle disease and avian influenza. Produces vaccines for national livestock vaccination campaigns. Provides veterinary diagnostic laboratory services. Conducts disease surveillance and epidemiology. Trains veterinarians and animal health professionals. Researches antimicrobial resistance in livestock. Collaborates with FAO and international veterinary organizations. Addresses animal disease outbreaks threatening livestock sector. Nigeria's livestock sector critical but disease-prone. National War Museum is federal institution preserving Nigeria's military history and civil war heritage. Located in Umuahia, Abia State (former Biafran capital during civil war), operating under Federal Ministry of Information and Culture. Established to document Nigerian Civil War (1967-1970) and military history. Preserves artifacts from Nigerian Civil War. Exhibits weapons, uniforms and military equipment from war. Documents Biafran secession and federal military response. Preserves photographs and documents from civil war era. Promotes national reconciliation and peace education. Provides historical education on Nigeria's military conflicts. Exhibits post-independence military history. Honors fallen soldiers and war victims. Promotes understanding of civil war causes and consequences. Serves as memorial to 1-3 million estimated civil war deaths. Provides research resources on Nigerian military history. Attracts visitors learning about civil war history. Addresses sensitive topic - civil war remains contentious 50+ years later. Igbo perspectives on civil war, federal victory vs. Biafran defeat narratives. Critical for historical preservation, peace education and ensuring civil war horrors remembered to prevent recurrence. Location in former Biafra symbolic.

National Youth Service Corps is federal scheme deploying university graduates for one-year national service. Operating under Federal Ministry of Youth and Sports Development. Established 1973 post-civil war to promote national unity, integration and development. Mobilizes Nigerian graduates for mandatory one-year service. Deploys corps members (corpers) to states different from their origin promoting national integration. Operates orientation camps providing paramilitary training. Posts graduates to schools as teachers, hospitals as health workers, communities as development agents. Promotes national unity and ethnic integration post-civil war. Promotes youth empowerment and self-employment. Coordinates Community Development Service (CDS). Addresses insecurity affecting corps members - some states dangerous for deployment, kidnapping risks, Boko Haram-affected areas. Relocation requests increase due to insecurity. mda_name: 700. NATIONAL AGENCY FOR THE PROHIBITION OF TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS (NAPTIP)
mandate_description:
National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons is federal law enforcement agency combating human trafficking and modern slavery. Headquartered in Abuja with zonal offices, operating under Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs. Established to prevent trafficking, prosecute traffickers and protect victims. Investigates human trafficking cases and trafficking networks. Arrests and prosecutes human traffickers and smugglers. Rescues trafficking victims from exploitation. Provides shelter and rehabilitation for rescued victims. Addresses sex trafficking and forced prostitution. Combats child trafficking and child labor exploitation. Addresses forced labor and domestic servitude. Prevents trafficking to Europe (Libya route), Gulf States and within Nigeria. Conducts public awareness on trafficking dangers. Collaborates with immigration on border trafficking prevention. Works with IOM and international anti-trafficking organizations. Prosecutes trafficking cases in courts. Provides victim counseling and reintegration support. Addresses root causes - poverty, unemployment, irregular migration aspirations. Nigeria source, transit and destination for trafficking. Thousands trafficked annually, many perish in Sahara/Mediterranean attempting to reach Europe. Critical for victim protection, trafficker prosecution and preventing human trafficking destroying lives of vulnerable Nigerians especially women and children.

Nigerian Defence Academy is premier tri-service military university training commissioned officers for armed forces. Located in Kaduna, operating under Federal Ministry of Defence.
