mda_name: 626. NATIONAL OBSTETRIC FISTULA CENTRE (NOFIC), EDO STATE
mandate_description:
National Obstetric Fistula Centre is specialized federal hospital treating vesico-vaginal fistula (VVF) and recto-vaginal fistula. Located in Edo State, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established to address obstetric fistula crisis affecting thousands of Nigerian women. Obstetric fistula results from prolonged obstructed labor causing hole between birth canal and bladder/rectum, leading to constant leaking of urine/feces. Provides free surgical repair of VVF and RVF. Conducts complex fistula surgeries including revision cases. Offers comprehensive fistula care including pre-operative and post-operative management. Provides social reintegration support for fistula survivors. Addresses stigma and social exclusion facing fistula patients. Trains surgeons on fistula repair techniques. Conducts outreach programs identifying fistula cases in communities. Promotes safe childbirth preventing fistula. Collaborates with UNFPA, Fistula Foundation and international partners. Addresses maternal health crisis - Nigeria has high maternal mortality and fistula prevalence from poor obstetric care, early marriage, home deliveries and limited access to emergency obstetric care. Critical for women's health, dignity restoration and addressing preventable maternal morbidity.

National Gallery of Art is federal institution preserving, exhibiting and promoting Nigerian visual arts. Operating under Federal Ministry of Information and Culture. National Hajj Commission of Nigeria is federal agency regulating and coordinating Hajj pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Office of President. Established to organize, regulate and supervise Nigerian Muslims' annual Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca. Coordinates with Saudi Arabian authorities on Hajj arrangements. Registers Nigerian pilgrims and processes Hajj documentation. Negotiates Hajj quotas for Nigeria with Saudi Arabia. Provides Hajj orientation and education for pilgrims. Regulates Hajj tour operators and travel agents. Airlifts pilgrims to Saudi Arabia and back. Provides accommodation and welfare services in Mecca and Medina. Manages medical services for pilgrims. Ensures pilgrims' safety and security. Regulates Hajj costs preventing exploitation. Addresses challenges from high Hajj costs, limited quotas, logistics complexity and pilgrim welfare concerns. Nigeria sends 95,000+ pilgrims annually (within Saudi quota). Hajj is fifth pillar of Islam obligatory for able Muslims. Hajj operations involve billions of Naira. National Health Insurance Scheme is federal health insurance program providing healthcare financing and universal health coverage. Headquartered in Abuja, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Provides coverage for enrollees and dependents. Accredits healthcare providers (HMOs and hospitals). Regulates health insurance market. Promotes equity in healthcare access. Addresses out-of-pocket healthcare payments causing impoverishment. Coverage remains low - less than 5% population enrolled despite decades of operation. Formal Sector Social Health Insurance Program (FSSHIP) covers federal civil servants. Informal Sector Social Health Insurance Program targets informal workers, artisans and traders. National Horticultural Research Institute is federal agricultural research institution conducting research on fruits, vegetables and ornamental plants. Located in Ibadan, Oyo State, operating under Agricultural Research Council of Nigeria and Federal Ministry of Agriculture. National Human Rights Commission is independent federal agency protecting and promoting human rights. National Hydrographic Agency is specialized federal agency conducting hydrographic surveys and maritime charting. Operating under Nigerian Navy and Federal Ministry of Defence. National Identity Management Commission is federal agency managing national identity database and identity cards. National Inland Waterways Authority is federal agency regulating and developing inland water transportation. Headquartered in Lokoja, Kogi State (confluence of Niger and Benue Rivers), operating under Federal Ministry of Transportation. Established to develop, regulate and maintain Nigeria's inland waterways for navigation and transportation. Regulates water transportation on rivers, lakes and inland waterways. mda_name: 603. NATIONAL CENTRE FOR THE CONTROL OF SMALL ARMS AND LIGHT WEAPONS (NCCSALW)
mandate_description:
National Centre for the Control of Small Arms and Light Weapons is federal agency coordinating control and regulation of illicit proliferation of small arms and light weapons. Operating under Office of National Security Adviser. Established to address proliferation of illegal firearms threatening national security. Coordinates national action on small arms control implementing ECOWAS Convention. Conducts weapons collection and destruction programs. Monitors cross-border weapons trafficking. Collaborates with security agencies on arms control enforcement. Conducts awareness campaigns on dangers of illicit weapons. Supports disarmament programs in conflict-affected areas. Coordinates stockpile management preventing leakage from government arsenals. Addresses armed banditry, kidnapping and insurgency fueled by weapons proliferation. Collaborates with neighboring countries on transborder arms control. Engages civil society on peacebuilding and weapons reduction. Addresses challenges from porous borders, armed groups and limited enforcement capacity. Proliferation of AK-47s and other weapons enables banditry devastating northwestern Nigeria, farmer-herder conflicts and insurgency. mda_name: 607. NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES (NCPWD)
mandate_description:

Monitors compliance with disability laws and regulations. Investigates disability discrimination complaints. Collaborates with disability organizations and advocacy groups. Promotes assistive devices and rehabilitation services. Addresses challenges from limited enforcement, inadequate accessibility infrastructure and persistent discrimination. Protects archaeological sites including Nok terracotta sites, ancient Benin, Ife bronze works and historical locations. Manages national monuments and heritage sites. Conducts archaeological excavations and research. Collects, preserves and exhibits cultural artifacts and historical objects. Prevents illicit trafficking of cultural property and antiquities. Promotes cultural tourism and heritage education. Manages museum collections and conservation. Collaborates with UNESCO on World Heritage Sites. National Council on Climate Change is federal agency coordinating Nigeria's climate change response and climate policy. Operating under Office of President (previously under Federal Ministry of Environment). Established to coordinate climate change mitigation, adaptation and national climate action. Develops national climate change policy and strategies. Coordinates implementation of Nigeria's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under Paris Agreement. Promotes climate change mitigation reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Develops climate adaptation programs protecting vulnerable communities. Coordinates access to climate finance from Green Climate Fund and international sources. Mainstreams climate change into sector policies and planning. Promotes renewable energy and clean energy transition. Addresses deforestation and promotes reforestation. Conducts climate vulnerability assessments. Promotes climate-smart agriculture. Coordinates climate research and data collection. Provides climate change awareness and education. Collaborates with UNFCCC and international climate agencies. Addresses challenges from limited climate finance, implementation gaps and balancing development with emissions reduction. Nigeria vulnerable to climate impacts including flooding, droughts, desertification and sea level rise affecting coastal cities.

**Core Mandate:** To coordinate climate change response, implement NDCs, promote climate adaptation and mitigation, access climate finance and mainstream climate action across Nigeria's development.

National Counter Terrorism Centre is federal agency coordinating counter-terrorism strategy and operations. Operating under Office of National Security Adviser. Established to coordinate multi-agency counter-terrorism efforts against Boko Haram, ISWAP and other terrorist groups. Develops national counter-terrorism strategy and policies. Coordinates military, police, DSS and security agencies' counter-terrorism operations. Conducts terrorism threat analysis and intelligence assessments. Monitors terrorist activities and radicalization. Coordinates de-radicalization and counter-violent extremism programs. Addresses terrorism financing and fundraising. Promotes community engagement in counter-terrorism. Supports victims of terrorism. Coordinates regional counter-terrorism cooperation with Lake Chad Basin countries. Collaborates with international counter-terrorism partners. Addresses Boko Haram insurgency that killed 35,000+ and displaced millions since 2009. Counters ISWAP (Islamic State West Africa Province) operating in northeastern Nigeria. Addresses emerging terrorist threats and kidnapping-for-ransom groups. Critical for national security, coordinating fight against terrorism and protecting Nigerians from terrorist violence.

**Core Mandate:** To coordinate counter-terrorism strategy, integrate security agencies' operations, counter violent extremism, address terrorism financing and lead Nigeria's fight against Boko Haram and terrorist groups.

(t) Advance national security coordinating fight against Boko Haram, ISWAP and terrorism protecting Nigerians from terrorist violence that killed thousands and displaced millions

National Cybercrime Coordination Centre is federal agency coordinating cybersecurity and combating cybercrime. Operating under Office of National Security Adviser. Established to coordinate national response to cyber threats, cybercrime and cyber attacks. Coordinates cybersecurity across critical infrastructure sectors. Monitors cyber threats and cyber attacks. Investigates cybercrimes including online fraud, hacking and identity theft. Addresses "Yahoo Yahoo" (internet fraud/419 scams) damaging Nigeria's reputation. Combats Business Email Compromise scams targeting businesses globally. Coordinates cybersecurity incident response. Promotes cybersecurity awareness and safe internet practices. Collaborates with EFCC on internet fraud investigations. Coordinates with international cybercrime agencies (FBI, Interpol). Monitors dark web activities and cyber criminal networks. Addresses challenges from sophisticated cyber criminals, limited cyber forensics capacity and international jurisdictional issues. Nigeria notorious for internet fraud schemes with fraudsters (Yahoo Boys) stealing billions globally. Critical for cybersecurity, protecting critical infrastructure, combating cybercrime and improving Nigeria's international reputation.

**Core Mandate:** To coordinate cybersecurity, combat cybercrime including internet fraud, protect critical infrastructure, coordinate cyber incident response and improve Nigeria's cyber defense capabilities.

(t) Advance cybersecurity and combat cybercrime protecting critical infrastructure and improving Nigeria's reputation damaged by internet fraud through coordinated response to cyber threats

National Defence College is premier strategic leadership institution providing senior military and civilian leadership training. Located in Abuja, operating under Ministry of Defence. Established to train senior military officers, senior civil servants and private sector leaders on national security, defense strategy and strategic leadership. Provides Senior Course for Colonels/Brigadiers, equivalent civil servants and private sector executives. Covers national security strategy, defense policy and strategic studies. Promotes civil-military understanding and cooperation. Conducts research on security challenges and strategic issues. Trains on crisis management and decision-making. Studies geopolitics and international relations. Promotes whole-of-government approach to security. Graduates include future generals, permanent secretaries and CEOs. Collaborates with international war colleges and defense institutions. Conducts security seminars and strategic dialogue. Addresses challenges from evolving security threats (insurgency, terrorism, cybersecurity). Critical for strategic leadership development, national security planning and preparing Nigeria's future leaders for complex security environment. Equivalent to war colleges in other countries.

National Directorate of Employment is federal agency addressing unemployment through skills training, job creation and vocational programs. Headquartered in Abuja with offices nationwide, operating under Federal Ministry of Labour and Employment. Established in 1986 to tackle youth unemployment and provide skills for job seekers. Operates four main programs: Vocational Skills Development (VSD), Small Scale Enterprises (SSE), Special Public Works (SPW), and Rural Employment Promotion (REP). Provides free vocational skills training in trades (tailoring, welding, carpentry, etc.). Supports entrepreneurship and business startup training. Provides small business loans and grants to trained beneficiaries. Organizes public works programs creating temporary jobs. Promotes agricultural employment in rural areas. Conducts graduate attachment programs. Addresses youth unemployment estimated 40%+. Collaborates with states, private sector and training institutions. Faces challenges from limited funding, inadequate job creation and sustainability of trained beneficiaries' businesses. Nigeria has massive unemployment crisis with limited formal sector jobs. Critical for skills development, entrepreneurship and reducing unemployment especially among youth.

National Drug Law Enforcement Agency is premier federal law enforcement agency combating illicit drug trafficking, abuse and narcotics crimes. Headquartered in Abuja with commands nationwide and at borders/airports, operating under Federal Ministry of Justice. Established to enforce drug laws, combat drug trafficking and reduce drug abuse. Conducts drug interdiction at borders, seaports and airports. Arrests drug traffickers and prosecutes narcotics offenses. Seizes and destroys illicit drugs including cocaine, heroin, cannabis and methamphetamine. Conducts drug demand reduction and prevention programs. Operates rehabilitation centers for drug users. Conducts drug testing and workplace drug screening. Collaborates with international drug enforcement agencies (DEA, Interpol). Addresses drug trafficking through Nigerian airports (drug mules). Combats domestic drug abuse and addiction. Under current leadership (since 2021), significantly increased drug seizures and arrests. Addresses challenges from international drug cartels, corruption and limited rehabilitation capacity. Nigeria is transit route for cocaine from South America to Europe and experiences growing methamphetamine production. Critical for drug control, public health and combating organized narcotics crimes.

(t) Advance drug control and public health combating drug trafficking through Nigerian routes, reducing drug abuse and rehabilitating addicts protecting Nigerians from narcotics epidemic

National Ear Care Centre is specialized federal healthcare facility providing ear, nose and throat (ENT) services. Located in Kaduna, Kaduna State, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Nigerian Navy is maritime military service protecting territorial waters, economic zones and providing naval defense. Operating under Federal Ministry of Defence. Established to defend Nigeria's maritime domain, protect offshore assets and secure sea lines of communication. Defends Nigerian territorial waters and Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ). Protects offshore oil installations and platforms from attacks. Combats oil theft, illegal bunkering and pipeline vandalism at sea. Addresses piracy and maritime criminality in Gulf of Guinea. Provides maritime security and coastal patrol. Operates naval bases including Apapa, Calabar, Port Harcourt, Warri. Conducts anti-piracy operations in territorial waters. Collaborates with multinational maritime forces. Supports fisheries protection preventing illegal fishing. Conducts search and rescue operations at sea. Operates naval ships, patrol boats and aviation assets. Trains naval personnel and marine commandos. Faces challenges from aging fleet, limited modern platforms, oil theft costing billions and Gulf of Guinea piracy (once world's worst). Recent ship acquisitions improving capacity. Nigerian Railway Corporation is federal agency operating railway services and managing rail infrastructure. Operating under Federal Ministry of Transportation. Established to provide rail transport, maintain railway infrastructure and support railway development. Operates passenger rail services on existing routes. Provides freight rail transport for cargo. Maintains narrow gauge railway network (3,505 km inherited colonial lines). Operates Lagos-Ibadan standard gauge railway (recently commissioned). Manages Abuja-Kaduna standard gauge line. Operates Itakpe-Ajaokuta-Warri railway. Provides commuter rail services in Lagos. Maintains railway stations and terminals. Addresses railway infrastructure decay from decades of neglect. Promotes railway as road transport alternative. Supports economic development through rail connectivity. Faces massive challenges - colonial narrow gauge network collapsed, decades of underinvestment, competing with road transport, limited modern infrastructure. Railway renaissance underway with Chinese-funded standard gauge projects but progress slow. Railway once vital but declined to near-total collapse before recent revival efforts. Critical for transport diversification, economic development and reviving railway infrastructure despite decades of neglect.

Nigerian Safety Investigation Bureau is independent federal agency investigating aviation, marine and railway accidents. Operating autonomously under NSIB Act. Established to investigate transportation accidents, determine causes and improve safety through recommendations. Investigates aircraft accidents and serious incidents. Conducts marine accident investigations. Investigates railway accidents and incidents. Determines accident causes and contributing factors. Issues safety recommendations preventing recurrence. Operates independently from regulatory agencies (NCAA, NIMASA). Publishes accident investigation reports. Promotes transportation safety culture. Collaborates with international investigation agencies (NTSB, AAIB). Implements ICAO Annex 13 standards for aircraft investigations. Addresses challenges from limited investigation capacity, equipment needs and implementation of safety recommendations. Aviation accidents require thorough investigation. Dana Air crash (2012), Associated Airlines crash (2013) highlighted importance. Independence from regulators critical for objective investigations. (t) Advance transportation safety through independent thorough investigations preventing future accidents despite capacity constraints

Nigerian Television Authority is federal government-owned television network broadcasting nationwide. Operating under Federal Ministry of Information and Culture. Nigerian Tourism Development Corporation is federal agency promoting tourism, developing tourist attractions and supporting hospitality industry. Nigerians in Diaspora Commission is federal agency engaging Nigerian diaspora and harnessing diaspora contributions. Operating under Office of President. Promotes diaspora investment in Nigeria. Facilitates diaspora remittances (over $20 billion annually). Supports diaspora business and entrepreneurship. Addresses welfare of Nigerians abroad. Nigerian Postal Service is federal agency providing postal and courier services nationwide. Operating under Federal Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy. Established to provide mail delivery, postal services and support e-commerce logistics. Provides mail and parcel delivery services nationwide. Operates post offices across Nigeria. Issues postage stamps and postal products. Provides courier and express delivery services. Supports e-commerce and online shopping logistics. Provides postal money orders and financial services. Operates postal savings and microfinance. Issues stamp duties and revenue stamps. Provides government document delivery. Collaborates with international postal unions (UPU). Faces existential challenges from digital communication replacing mail, courier companies (DHL, FedEx) competition, e-commerce logistics competitors, declining mail volumes and financial struggles. Email, WhatsApp replacing letters. Postal services globally struggling with digitalization. NIPOST requires transformation to remain relevant. Critical for last-mile delivery, financial inclusion and postal services despite digital disruption threatening traditional postal model.

Noma Children Hospital is specialized federal hospital treating noma disease in children. Located in Sokoto, operating under Federal Ministry of Health. mda_name: 779. NURSING AND MIDWIFERY COUNCIL OF NIGERIA (NMCN)
mandate_description:
Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria is federal regulatory body for nursing and midwifery professions. Operating under Federal Ministry of Health. Established to regulate nursing practice, register nurses/midwives and ensure professional standards. Regulates nursing and midwifery professions nationwide. Registers qualified nurses and midwives. Licenses practicing nurses and midwives. Accredits Schools of Nursing and Schools of Midwifery. Sets nursing education standards and curricula. Conducts nursing examinations and certification. Issues annual practicing licenses. Enforces nursing ethics and professional conduct. Addresses nursing malpractice and incompetence. Promotes nursing education quality. Collaborates with teaching hospitals on nurse training. Addresses challenges from nurse shortages (Nigeria has ~200,000+ registered nurses for 200M+ population - massive deficit), inadequate nursing schools, nurse migration abroad (brain drain to UK, US, Canada) and quality concerns. mandate_description:

Promotes Nigerian agricultural interests internationally. Participates in FAO governance and policy-making. Coordinates food security and nutrition programs. Accesses FAO support for livestock, fisheries and forestry. Promotes sustainable agriculture and rural development cooperation. Collaborates on agricultural research and technology transfer. Addresses challenges from limited engagement, coordination gaps with Abuja and underutilization of FAO resources. Nigeria major agricultural country requiring robust FAO engagement. mda_name: 787. OFFICE OF THE SENIOR SPECIAL ASSISTANT TO THE PRESIDENT ON MDGs (OSSAP-MDGs)
mandate_description:
Office of the Senior Special Assistant on MDGs coordinated Nigeria's Millennium Development Goals implementation. Operating under Office of President. Established to coordinate MDG achievement, manage MDG-related programs and report on progress. MDGs (2000-2015) replaced by Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 2015. Office likely transitioned to SDGs coordination. Coordinated Nigeria's MDG implementation across sectors. Managed MDG-related development programs and projects. Reported on Nigeria's progress toward eight MDGs (poverty, education, health, gender, child mortality, maternal health, diseases, environment). Coordinated with MDAs on MDG targets. Accessed international MDG funding and support. Promoted poverty reduction and social development. Coordinated health sector MDG programs. Supported education access and gender equality initiatives. Addressed challenges from limited MDG achievement - Nigeria missed most MDG targets by 2015. Poverty remained high, maternal/child mortality excessive, education gaps persisted. Office represents development coordination efforts. Now likely focused on SDGs implementation post-2015.

mda_name: 788. OFFICE OF THE SURVEYOR GENERAL OF THE FEDERATION (OSGF)
mandate_description:
Office of the Surveyor General of the Federation is federal agency conducting national surveys, mapping and geospatial data management. Operating under Federal Ministry of Works and Housing. Established to conduct geodetic surveys, produce national maps and manage Nigeria's geospatial infrastructure. Conducts geodetic and cadastral surveys nationwide. Produces national maps and topographic surveys. Manages national geodetic control network. Provides geospatial data and mapping services. Conducts boundary surveys for states and LGAs. Supports land administration and property mapping. Develops national spatial data infrastructure. Operates geographic information systems (GIS). Provides surveying standards and regulations. Trains surveyors and geomatics professionals. Collaborates with state surveyors general. Addresses challenges from outdated maps, limited modern surveying equipment, boundary disputes and inadequate geospatial data. Nigeria's maps often colonial-era requiring updating. Boundary disputes between states require accurate surveys. Critical for mapping, land administration, boundary demarcation and providing geospatial data supporting development despite outdated infrastructure.

Provides water for agriculture, industry and domestic use. Operates dams and reservoirs in basin. Addresses flooding in river catchments. Develops water supply infrastructure. mda_name: 790. OIL AND GAS FREE ZONES AUTHORITY (OGFZA)
mandate_description:

mandate_description:

Allocates federally-collected revenues among federal, state and local governments. Current allocation formula distributes revenues across government tiers. Implements 13% derivation for oil-producing states.
